newsitem.title: CHILE: Chuquicamata supervisors vote on pay offer.
newsitem.headline: Chuquicamata supervisors vote on pay offer.

text.p: About 400 out of 670 supervisors at Codelco's Chuquicamata mine have cast their ballots in a strike vote Tuesday, a union leader said, but he declined to predict which way the vote might go.
The union will have a result some time after 1800 local/2200 GMT, when voting by law must end, said union president Grimaldo Ponce.
The union, joining 670 supervisors at the state copper company's largest mine, was not recommending either a vote in favor or against a company pay and benefits offer, Ponce said.
"Each supervisor can make his own calculation about what the offer means to him and decide which way to vote. We leave it up to each person's conscience," he told Reuters by telephone from the mine.
He earlier said the supervisors were unlikely to go on strike. Later he declined to make predictions, saying do so would prejudice the vote.
